cat > /tmp/check.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2, sys
d=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1],index_col=0); o=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[2],index_col=0)
img=cv2.imread(sys.argv[3]); H,W=img.shape[:2]
assert list(d.columns)==list(o.columns) and len(d)==len(o)
same=[c for c in d.columns if c not in "xmin ymin xmax ymax coords_x coords_y".split()]
assert d[same].equals(o[same])
acc=np.zeros((H,W),int); vis=img.copy()
for i,r in o.iterrows():
    xs=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))));ys=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(','))))
    p=np.stack([xs,ys],1)
    rect=np.all(np.isin(xs,[xs.min(),xs.max()])) and np.all(np.isin(ys,[ys.min(),ys.max()]))
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[p],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m,connectivity=4)
    assert not rect and n==2, i
    assert (xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max())==(r.xmin,r.xmax,r.ymin,r.ymax)
    acc+=m; cv2.polylines(vis,[p],True,(0,255,0),1)
print("max overlap", acc.max(), "npts", o.coords_x.str.count(',').describe()[['min','mean']].tolist())
try:
    from shapely.geometry import Polygon
    P=[Polygon(np.stack([list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))),list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(','))) ],1)) for _,r in o.iterrows()]
    print("valid",all(p.is_valid for p in P),"max geom overlap",max(P[i].intersection(P[j]).area for i in range(len(P)) for j in range(i+1,len(P))))
except ImportError: print("no shapely")
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
EOF
